title: 軟體使用
description: 各種軟體操作的表達方式

sentences.en: The spreadsheet formula that I entered in cell B2, which references data from multiple sheets, keeps returning an error value.
sentences.zh: 我在B2儲存格輸入的引用多個工作表資料的試算表公式，一直回傳錯誤值。

sentences.en: After installing the latest software update, which includes several security patches, the application became noticeably more responsive.
sentences.zh: 安裝了包含數個安全修補程式的最新軟體更新後，應用程式變得明顯更加靈敏。

sentences.en: The word processor crashed without warning while I was editing a thirty-page report, and I lost all unsaved changes.
sentences.zh: 文書處理器在我編輯一份三十頁報告時毫無預警地當掉了，我失去了所有未儲存的變更。

sentences.en: To merge two PDF documents into a single file, you can use the built-in feature or download a free third-party tool.
sentences.zh: 要將兩個PDF文件合併成單一檔案，你可以使用內建功能或下載免費的第三方工具。

sentences.en: The video editing software, which requires a powerful graphics card and substantial RAM, allows me to produce professional-quality content.
sentences.zh: 影片編輯軟體需要強大的顯示卡和足夠的記憶體，讓我能製作出專業品質的內容。

sentences.en: Customizing the toolbar in my design application by adding frequently used tools has significantly streamlined my daily workflow.
sentences.zh: 在我的設計應用程式中透過加入常用工具來自訂工具列，大幅簡化了我的日常工作流程。

sentences.en: The auto-save feature, which creates a backup every five minutes, has saved me from losing important work on numerous occasions.
sentences.zh: 每五分鐘建立一次備份的自動儲存功能，在許多場合拯救了我免於失去重要的工作成果。

sentences.en: Before exporting the presentation as a PDF, make sure all embedded fonts are included so that the formatting remains consistent.
sentences.zh: 在將簡報匯出為PDF之前，請確保包含所有嵌入字型，這樣格式才會保持一致。

sentences.en: The plugin that I installed to enhance the photo editor's capabilities added over fifty new filters and adjustment tools.
sentences.zh: 我為了增強照片編輯器功能而安裝的外掛，新增了超過五十個新濾鏡和調整工具。

sentences.en: Learning to use keyboard shortcuts in any software application can reduce the time spent on repetitive tasks by nearly half.
sentences.zh: 學會在任何軟體應用程式中使用鍵盤快捷鍵，可以將花在重複性任務上的時間減少近一半。

sentences.en: The database management system, designed to handle millions of records efficiently, requires proper indexing to maintain fast query speeds.
sentences.zh: 設計來有效處理數百萬筆記錄的資料庫管理系統，需要適當的索引來維持快速的查詢速度。

sentences.en: After configuring the email client to filter incoming messages automatically, my inbox became much more organized and manageable.
sentences.zh: 設定電子郵件用戶端自動過濾收到的訊息之後，我的收件匣變得更加有條理且易於管理。

sentences.en: The collaboration feature in this document editor, which allows multiple users to edit simultaneously, has transformed how our team works.
sentences.zh: 這個文件編輯器中的協作功能允許多位使用者同時編輯，徹底改變了我們團隊的工作方式。

sentences.en: Compressing large image files using specialized software reduces their size without significantly affecting the visual quality.
sentences.zh: 使用專業軟體壓縮大型圖片檔案可以減小其大小，而不會明顯影響視覺品質。

sentences.en: The accounting software that our company adopted last quarter integrates seamlessly with our existing payroll and invoicing systems.
sentences.zh: 我們公司上季度採用的會計軟體與我們現有的薪資和發票系統無縫整合。

sentences.en: To undo multiple actions at once in most editing software, you can access the history panel and revert to a previous state.
sentences.zh: 要在大多數編輯軟體中一次復原多個動作，你可以存取歷史面板並還原到之前的狀態。

sentences.en: The project management tool, which tracks deadlines and assigns tasks to team members, sends automatic reminders before due dates.
sentences.zh: 追蹤截止日期並將任務分配給團隊成員的專案管理工具，會在到期日前發送自動提醒。

sentences.en: Converting a document from one format to another, such as from Word to PDF, sometimes causes formatting issues that need manual correction.
sentences.zh: 將文件從一種格式轉換成另一種，例如從Word轉成PDF，有時會造成需要手動修正的格式問題。

sentences.en: The version control system that developers use to manage source code allows them to track every change and revert mistakes easily.
sentences.zh: 開發者用來管理原始碼的版本控制系統，讓他們能追蹤每個變更並輕鬆還原錯誤。

sentences.en: After upgrading to the premium version of the design software, I gained access to thousands of additional templates and stock images.
sentences.zh: 升級到設計軟體的進階版本後，我獲得了數千個額外模板和庫存圖片的存取權。

sentences.en: The antivirus program running in the background, which scans all downloaded files automatically, detected a potential threat this morning.
sentences.zh: 在背景執行並自動掃描所有下載檔案的防毒程式，今天早上偵測到一個潛在威脅。

sentences.en: Enabling automatic updates for all installed applications ensures that you always have the latest features and security improvements.
sentences.zh: 為所有已安裝的應用程式啟用自動更新，確保你始終擁有最新的功能和安全改進。

sentences.en: The cloud-based office suite, which eliminates the need for local installation, allows users to create documents from any device.
sentences.zh: 雲端辦公套件不需要本機安裝，讓使用者能從任何裝置建立文件。

sentences.en: Batch processing hundreds of images through an automated script saves hours compared to editing each photograph individually.
sentences.zh: 透過自動化腳本批次處理數百張圖片，與逐一編輯每張照片相比節省了數小時。

sentences.en: The software license that I purchased for my small business allows installation on up to five devices with a single annual payment.
sentences.zh: 我為小型企業購買的軟體授權允許以單次年付安裝在最多五台裝置上。

sentences.en: Importing data from a CSV file into the analytics platform requires mapping each column to the corresponding field in the database.
sentences.zh: 將CSV檔案的資料匯入分析平台，需要將每一欄對應到資料庫中相應的欄位。

sentences.en: The text editor favored by programmers, which supports syntax highlighting for dozens of languages, is available as a free download.
sentences.zh: 程式設計師喜愛的文字編輯器支援數十種語言的語法高亮，可以免費下載。

sentences.en: Setting up automatic backups through the software's built-in scheduler ensures that your data is protected without requiring manual intervention.
sentences.zh: 透過軟體內建的排程器設定自動備份，確保你的資料在不需要手動操作的情況下受到保護。

sentences.en: The rendering process for this three-dimensional animation, which involves millions of calculations per frame, took over twelve hours to complete.
sentences.zh: 這個三維動畫的算繪過程涉及每幀數百萬次計算，花了超過十二小時才完成。

sentences.en: Uninstalling bloatware that came pre-installed on the computer freed up several gigabytes of storage and improved overall system performance.
sentences.zh: 解除安裝電腦上預裝的臃腫軟體釋放了數GB的儲存空間，並改善了整體系統效能。
